title: Stock Purchase Agreement
description: Key terms of a stock purchase agreement under which a buyer acquires shares of a company from a seller, as they would be captured by a deal team, lender or regulator reviewing the transaction.

agreement_date.description: Date the stock purchase agreement is made and entered into (or dated as of), in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name.description: Legal name of the seller, as defined in the agreement's preamble.

entity_type.description: Form of entity of the seller, e.g. private limited liability company, corporation.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction under whose laws the seller is formed, e.g. the Netherlands.

name.description: Legal name of the buyer, as defined in the agreement's preamble.

entity_type.description: Form of entity of the buyer, e.g. limited liability company.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction under whose laws the buyer is formed, e.g. Delaware.

company.description: The company whose stock is being sold (the target).

name.description: Legal name of the company whose stock is sold.

jurisdiction.description: State or country of incorporation of the company.

operating_subsidiary.description: Name of the principal operating subsidiary the company owns, if the recitals name one.

business_description.description: Short description of the business the company or its subsidiary carries on, as stated in the recitals.

share_class.description: Class of stock, e.g. common stock.

par_value.description: Par value per share, in the stated currency.

percent_of_outstanding.description: Percentage of the company's outstanding ownership interest the shares represent.

purchase_price.description: Total purchase price payable for the stock at closing, as a number without currency symbols or separators.

purchase_price_currency.description: Currency of the purchase price, e.g. USD.

payment_method.description: How the purchase price is paid, e.g. wire transfer of immediately available funds.

earnest_money.description: Amount of earnest money or deposit the buyer must deliver after signing.

closing.description: Where and when the closing takes place.

location.description: Place where the closing is held: the firm or office name and its address.

time.description: Time of day the closing is held, as printed.

timing_condition.description: When the closing occurs relative to satisfaction of the closing conditions, e.g. no later than the fifth business day after the conditions are satisfied or waived.

seller_parent_guarantor.description: Name of the seller's parent company that guarantees the seller's obligations, if any.

buyer_parent_guarantor.description: Name of the buyer's parent company that guarantees the buyer's obligations, if any.

termination_fee.description: Amount of the termination fee payable on termination in the circumstances the agreement specifies, if stated.

outside_date_terms.description: The deadline after which either party may terminate if the closing has not occurred (the outside date), as the agreement states it. This may be a calendar date or a period measured from an event, e.g. twelve months after a regulatory filing; quote the period as written.

governing_law.description: State or country whose law governs the agreement.

signatories.description: Signature blocks on the agreement's execution page, one per signing party.

party.description: The entity on whose behalf the block is signed.

signer_name.description: Name printed under the signature line.

signer_title.description: Title printed under the signer's name.

is_signed.description: True if the signature line bears a signature.
